messages:
Priya S: heads upnoticed a small cluster of invoice preview adjustments where EU tenants got billed in USD after the geo-fallback rollout. looks like route_priority fallback changed the region tag on some events. anyone seen this?
Omar N: yep saw a 0.5% spike in USD conversions for eu-prod yesterday evening around 18:40 UTC. replayed a few events and region header flips when fallback -> global occurs.
Dana R: is this the config we pushed that prefers capacity over region for low-latency? I thought we preserved pricing_region on routing.
Priya S: that's the thingedge now routes to best-effort pool and we forgot to carry pricing_region through the proxy rewrite. route_origin preserved but pricing_region got recalculated downstream.
Alex K: quick impact: pricing engine charges by pricing_region, invoice preview aggregates by invoice_region. mismatch yields preview diff and sometimes manual adjustments. not great for CS.
Omar N: proposed fixes: (1) patch proxy to copy pricing_region header when fallback triggers, (2) in ingest pipeline if pricing_region absent, fallback to tenant default (cheap but might hide bugs), (3) post-process preview: if route_origin cluster != pricing_region, flag preview with note.
Dana R: (1) is best correctness-wise. small proxy patch, low risk. need to ensure header copying is idempotent and respects tenant overrides.
Priya S: agree. we should canary (1) for the eu-region tenants affected. Omar, can you add a switch in proxy so it's on for a tenant-set?
Omar N: yes will add env var gating and a tenant canary list. ETA ~8 hours for PR.
Alex K: telemetry: add an alert if invoice-preview currency mismatch rate > 0.1% across non-canary tenants for 1h. Also add a metric dimension pricing_region_mismatch=true so we can track.
Dana R: console UX ask: show a tiny badge on invoice-preview "region mismatch" with hover text: "Preview uses pricing_region X but event routing used Y; final invoice may differ." That helps CS triage.
Priya S: also need a migration note: any downstream accounting jobs that assume invoice_region==pricing_region might need reconciliation. tagging finance for FYI.
Omar N: metering-bot: kicked a local replay for 5 sample EU tenants with the proxy patch toggled.
metering-bot: replay-run 7812345700: 5 tenants, 320 events, pre-patch mismatches: 12 events with pricing_region absent, post-patch mismatches: 0. details: https://internal/ci/replay/7812345700
Dana R: nice. Omar please add a unit test ensuring pricing_region header survives retry & proxy rewrite paths. also confirm header size/encoding fine for existing WAF rules.
Omar N: will add tests. Also adding a short circuit: if tenant.has_explicit_pricing_region then proxy honors it and doesn't copy.
Priya S: next steps summary: Omar -> PR + tests + canary (ETA 8h). Alex -> alert + metric (ETA 2h). Dana -> console badge mock + link to runbook (ETA 1 day). I'll notify finance and CS with the preview note.
Alex K: thanks. if patch clears canary in 6h we'll roll to prod midnight window. :thumbsup:
